Own password change module: server

Source: R/mod-password.R
aa_password_server.Rd

The user confirms the current password and sets a new one (aa_change_own_password()). Auto-login tokens of the other sessions are revoked, the current session keeps working. The module reports the change to the on_event hook with the password_changed event.

Usage

aa_password_server(id, conn, auth, settings = aa_settings(), on_event = NULL)

Arguments

id

Module id, the same as in aa_password_ui().

conn

Database connection.

auth

Authentication object, the result of aa_auth_server().

settings

Settings, the result of aa_settings().

on_event

Event hook function(event, user, session_id, value) or NULL.

Value

A list with the reactive value changed: the number of successful password changes in this session (can be used to close a window or show a message).

See also

aa_password_ui()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
auth <- aa_auth_server("auth", conn)
aa_password_server("password", conn, auth, on_event = log_event)
} # }
